'''Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps''' was a faction made primarily of [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] that countered the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-loyal [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

==History==
The organization fled [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] after the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] summoned the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to intervene in the planet's Civil War with the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

The company operated a [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps shipyards|shipyard]] on the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] water world of [[Minntooine/Legends|Minntooine]] where they cooperated with the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] foremen and [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]] to produce [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]]. They also had factories on the Quarren colony world of [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]] where they constructed [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyers]] at [[Pammant Docks/Legends|Pammant Docks]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] flagships, the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] and [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] were also built there by the company.<ref name="TCW:TVG" />
